name: qsv-readstat
description: Convert SAS (`.sas7bdat`, `.xpt`), Stata (`.dta`) & SPSS (`.sav`, `.zsav`, `.por`) files to CSV, preserving the underlying codes of labelled values by default. Also dumps the rich variable metadata these formats carry - variable labels, value labels, missing-value codes, measure & display settings - with `--metadata`.

args.name: input
args.description: Input CSV file. If not specified, reads from stdin.

options.description: Number of rows to read into memory at a time.
The delimiter to use when writing CSV data. Must be a single character.
Dump variable metadata instead of the data. Valid values: none, csv, json, pretty-json.
Write output to <file> instead of stdout.

Decode coded values to their label strings (e.g. 1 becomes "Male") instead of writing the underlying codes. Stata & SPSS only - SAS keeps its value labels in a separate .sas7bcat catalog, which this command does not read yet.
